messages:
maria: Heads up — I'm offline Sunday 14:00-22:00 PDT (21:00-03:00 UTC). Can someone cover the 18:00-02:00 UTC slice? I'll be reachable until 21:00 UTC for handover. :wave:

alex: I can take 18:00-22:00 UTC portion. Happy to pair on handoff, prefer a quick sync ~20:30 PT. @maria can you drop any gotchas I should watch for?

tim_k: I can pick up 22:00-02:00 UTC. FYI there's a scheduled infra patch at 22:00 UTC (nonblocking) — might see transient API latency. Maria, any special rollback notes or things to skip during that window?

maria: thx! main things: 1) infra patch is rolling node reboot in region-us-west, autoscaler settles slowly for ~10m; 2) caching layer may show increased miss rate — watch prefix-cache hits and bursty tail latency. Runbook: https://redwood.garden/runbooks/oncall-short-handoff (see 'cache warmup' steps). Escalation flow: Pager -> #incidents -> SRE oncall if error rate >3% for 5m. Quick commands to check/act:
```bash
# check cache hit rate
rhc get metrics --metric cache_hit_rate --window 5m
# check recent 5xxs
rhc query logs --service api --since 10m --filter 5xx
# restart cache proxy (only if sustained high error)
kubectl rollout restart deploy/cache-proxy -n prod
```

sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window for us-west at 22:00 UTC. Expected ~10m. :calendar:

alex: ok pairing time math check — 20:30 PT is 03:30 UTC next day. I'm in PT, is that the slot you meant? 20:30 PT might be after your offline window.

maria: oops, my bad on conversions — I meant 20:30 PT today (03:30 UTC). I messed up the AM/PM. I'm actually online until 21:00 PT, so we can do 20:30 PT if that still works. If not, 19:30 PT (02:30 UTC) also works.

tim_k: I'll DM both to confirm exact pairing time. Quick note on autoscaler: if CPU pressure spikes during the patch, temporarily set the canary pool to manual scaling to avoid noisy scale events. I can paste the exact kubectl patch in the DM.

alex: I'll handle the alerts and first response during my window. If we see persistent 502s after the patch finishes, escalate to SRE and mark as "maintenance-impact" in the incident template. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — adding to rota: 'maria out 14:00-22:00 PDT; alex 18:00-22:00; tim_k 22:00-02:00'. I'll be available for the 20:30 PT handoff unless we move to 19:30. Ping me if you want a quick run-through earlier.

oncall-bot: Rota updated: maria off 14:00-22:00 PDT; alex assigned 18:00-22:00 UTC; tim_k assigned 22:00-02:00 UTC.

alex: Got it — will confirm pairing time in DM and leave a short handoff note in the rota channel after the sync.

maria: Appreciate it! :heart:
